sentences.text: Shri Asha Ram Shivhare, Advocate for the petitioners.
Shri Anurag Sharma, Public Prosecutor for State.
Record of both the Courts below has been received.
Heard on admission.
Revision appears to be arguable is admitted for hearing.
Heard on I.A. No.15788/2025, which is first application under Section 397(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of petitioners.

Both the petitioners have been convicted for the offence under Sections 467, 468, 471 and 420 of IPC and sentenced to suffer 2 years RI with a fine of Rs.500/-, 1 year RI with fine of Rs.200(3 counts) with default stipulation which has been upheld by the appellate Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioners contended that the petitioners have been wrongly convicted by the Trial Court on the basis of improper appreciation of evidence.
There is material contradictions and ommissions in the statement of prosecution witness.
There is a strong case in favour of the petitioners.
During trial as well as appellate stage, they were remained on bail.
Petitioner No.1 has suffered jail incarceration for four and half months and petitioner No.2 has suffered jail incarceration for seven and half months.
Final conclusion of this revision will take a long time.
They are permanent resident of District Gwalior.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence of both the petitioners till the final disposal of this criminal revision.
Heard both the parties and perused the record.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of the allegation levelled against the petitioners and also taking note of the fact that the final conclusion of the petitioners will also take sufficiently long time, I deem it proper to suspend the remaining custodial sentence of the petitioners.

Accordingly, I.A. No.15788/2025 is allowed and it is directed that subject to deposit of fine amount,
if not already deposited, and subject to furnishing personal bond by both the petitioners in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned Trial Court, the execution of remaining custodial part of the sentence of the petitioners shall remain suspended, till final disposal of this petition.
The petitioners after being enlarged on bail shall mark their presence before the Registry of this Court on 18.11.2025 and on all such subsequent dates, which are fixed in this behalf.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.
